items.facts_min_first: Kechqurun harorat {M}°C ni ko'rsatdi, ertalab esa harorat {S}°C edi.
items.facts_sub_first: Ertalab harorat {S}°C edi, kechqurun esa harorat {M}°C ni ko'rsatdi.
items.question: Ertalabdan kechgacha harorat qanday o'zgardi?
items.agreement_note: '°C' is written directly after the numeral as a symbol, like currency notation; Uzbek nouns after cardinal numerals stay in the bare singular form for any integer, so no agreement issue arises.
items.gloss_en: In the evening the temperature showed M°C, while in the morning it had been S°C. How did the temperature change from morning to evening?

items.facts_min_first: Aksiya kun yakunida {M} dollar narxda yopildi, kun boshida esa narxi {S} dollar edi.
items.facts_sub_first: Kun boshida aksiya narxi {S} dollar edi, kun yakunida esa {M} dollar narxda yopildi.
items.question: Aksiya narxi kun davomida qanday o'zgardi?
items.agreement_note: 'dollar' is a bare count noun following the numeral, invariant for any integer in Uzbek (no plural/case marking triggered by the numeral).
items.gloss_en: At the end of the day the stock closed at M dollars, while at the start of the day the price had been S dollars. How did the stock price change over the day?

items.facts_min_first: Ko'lning suv sathi kechqurun {M} santimetr belgisini ko'rsatdi, ertalab esa sath {S} santimetr edi.
items.facts_sub_first: Ertalab ko'lning suv sathi {S} santimetr edi, kechqurun esa sath {M} santimetr belgisini ko'rsatdi.
items.question: Kun davomida ko'lning suv sathi qanday o'zgardi?
items.distractor_sentence: Bu ko'l atrofida {D} ta dam olish maskani joylashgan.
items.agreement_note: 'santimetr' is an invariant bare noun after any numeral.
items.gloss_en: In the evening the lake's water level showed the M centimetre mark, while in the morning the level had been S centimetres. How did the lake's water level change during the day?

items.facts_min_first: Uchar apparat parvoz oxirida {M} metr balandlikda uchdi, boshida esa balandligi {S} metr edi.
items.facts_sub_first: Parvoz boshida uchar apparat balandligi {S} metr edi, oxirida esa {M} metr balandlikda uchdi.
items.question: Parvoz davomida balandlik qanday o'zgardi?
items.distractor_sentence: Bu parvozda {D} ta yo'lovchi bor edi.
items.agreement_note: 'metr' is a bare invariant noun after any numeral.
items.gloss_en: At the end of the flight the aircraft was flying at an altitude of M metres, while at the start its altitude had been S metres. How did the altitude change during the flight?

items.facts_min_first: Bemorning vazni tekshiruv oxirida {M} kilogramm bo'ldi, boshida esa vazni {S} kilogramm edi.
items.facts_sub_first: Tekshiruv boshida bemorning vazni {S} kilogramm edi, oxirida esa vazni {M} kilogramm bo'ldi.
items.question: Tekshiruv davomida bemorning vazni qanday o'zgardi?
items.agreement_note: 'kilogramm' is a bare invariant noun after any numeral.
items.gloss_en: At the end of the check-up the patient's weight was M kilograms, while at the start the weight had been S kilograms. How did the patient's weight change during the check-up?

items.facts_min_first: Qishloqning aholisi yil oxirida {M} kishini tashkil etdi, yil boshida esa aholisi {S} kishi edi.
items.facts_sub_first: Yil boshida qishloqning aholisi {S} kishi edi, yil oxirida esa aholisi {M} kishini tashkil etdi.
items.question: Yil davomida qishloq aholisi qanday o'zgardi?
items.agreement_note: 'kishi' is a bare count noun (person), invariant after any numeral in Uzbek.
items.gloss_en: At the end of the year the village's population was M people, while at the start of the year the population had been S people. How did the village's population change during the year?

items.facts_min_first: Mashinaning spidometri yo'l oxirida {M} km/soatni ko'rsatdi, yo'l boshida esa tezlik {S} km/soat edi.
items.facts_sub_first: Yo'l boshida mashinaning tezligi {S} km/soat edi, yo'l oxirida esa spidometr {M} km/soatni ko'rsatdi.
items.question: Yo'l davomida mashina tezligi qanday o'zgardi?
items.agreement_note: 'km/soat' is a symbol written directly after the numeral, invariant for any integer.
items.gloss_en: At the end of the trip the car's speedometer showed M km/h, while at the start of the trip the speed had been S km/h. How did the car's speed change during the trip?

items.facts_min_first: Hisobga {M} dollar kiritilgan edi, keyin hisobdan {S} dollar yechib olindi.
items.facts_sub_first: Hisobdan {S} dollar yechib olindi, bundan oldin esa hisobga {M} dollar kiritilgan edi.
items.question: Hisobning joriy qoldig'i qancha?
items.agreement_note: 'dollar' is a bare invariant noun after any numeral.
items.gloss_en: M dollars had been deposited into the account, then S dollars were withdrawn from the account. What is the account's current balance?

items.facts_min_first: Oy davomida daromad {M} dollarni tashkil etdi, xarajatlar esa {S} dollar bo'ldi.
items.facts_sub_first: Oy davomida xarajatlar {S} dollar bo'ldi, daromad esa {M} dollarni tashkil etdi.
items.question: Oy uchun sof natija qancha bo'ldi?
items.agreement_note: 'dollar' is a bare invariant noun after any numeral.
items.gloss_en: During the month, income came to M dollars, while expenses were S dollars. What was the net result for the month?

items.facts_min_first: Mavsum davomida jamoa {M} ta gol urdi, darvozasiga esa {S} ta gol kirdi.
items.facts_sub_first: Mavsum davomida jamoa darvozasiga {S} ta gol kirdi, o'zi esa {M} ta gol urdi.
items.question: Mavsum uchun jamoaning gollar farqi qancha bo'ldi?
items.agreement_note: 'ta' is the generic Uzbek numeral classifier placed before the counted noun; it and the following noun stay in the same bare form for any integer.
items.gloss_en: During the season, the team scored M goals, while S goals were conceded against it. What was the team's goal difference for the season?

items.facts_min_first: Golfchi bu turda {M} ta zarba bilan o'yinni yakunladi, maydon normasi esa {S} ta zarba edi.
items.facts_sub_first: Bu turda maydon normasi {S} ta zarba edi, golfchi esa o'yinni {M} ta zarba bilan yakunladi.
items.question: Golfchi norma (par)ga nisbatan nechta zarba bilan o'ynadi?
items.agreement_note: 'ta zarba' (classifier + noun) is invariant for any integer.
items.gloss_en: In this round the golfer finished the game with M strokes, while the course's par was S strokes. How many strokes relative to par did the golfer play?

items.sign_convention: actual minus scheduled, late counted positive
items.facts_min_first: Poyezd yarim tundan keyingi {M}-daqiqada bekatga keldi, jadval bo'yicha esa {S}-daqiqada kelishi kerak edi.
items.facts_sub_first: Jadval bo'yicha poyezd yarim tundan keyingi {S}-daqiqada kelishi kerak edi, aslida esa {M}-daqiqada bekatga keldi.
items.question: Poyezd jadvaldan necha daqiqa farq bilan keldi? (Kechikish musbat hisoblanadi.)
items.distractor_sentence: Bu bekatda {D} ta yo'lovchi kutib turardi.
items.agreement_note: The suffix '-daqiqada' attaches directly to the bare numeral with no plural or class marking, identical in shape for any integer.
items.gloss_en: The train arrived at the station at minute M after midnight, while according to the schedule it was supposed to arrive at minute S after midnight. By how many minutes did the train differ from the schedule, with lateness counted as positive?

verifier.comment: Clock time as an ordinal minute after midnight is understandable but stiff.

items.sign_convention: team X's goals minus team Y's goals
items.facts_min_first: "Sharq" jamoasi bu o'yinda {M} ta gol urdi, "G'arb" jamoasi esa {S} ta gol urdi.
items.facts_sub_first: "G'arb" jamoasi bu o'yinda {S} ta gol urdi, "Sharq" jamoasi esa {M} ta gol urdi.
items.question: "Sharq" jamoasining "G'arb" jamoasiga nisbatan gol farqi qancha bo'ldi?
items.distractor_sentence: Bu o'yinni {D} nafar hakam kuzatib turdi.
items.agreement_note: 'ta gol' (classifier + noun) is invariant for any integer.
items.gloss_en: Team "East" scored M goals in this match, while team "West" scored S goals. What was team "East"'s goal difference relative to team "West"?
